newsitem.title: USA: Three return as US House agricultural subcommittee chairs.
newsitem.headline: Three return as US House agricultural subcommittee chairs.

text.p: Three out of five subcommittee chairmen on the U.S. House Agriculture Committee returned for another term in the new Congress, chairman Bob Smith announced Wednesday.
-- Bob Barrett, Nebraska Republican, general farm commodities subcommittee.
-- Tom Ewing, Illinois Republican, risk management and specialty crops subcommittee.
-- Bob Goodlatte, Virginia Republican, department operations, nutrition and foreign agriculture subcommittee.
Richard Pombo, California Republican, was named chairman of the livestock subcommittee to replace retired Wisconsin Republican Steve Gunderson.
Larry Combest, Texas Republican, was named chairman of the forestry, conservation and research subcommittee, replacing Colorado Republican Wayne Allard, who was elected to the Senate.
Combest also will be vice-chairman of the Agriculture Committee, said Smith, Oregon Republican.
Republicans and Democrats plan to appoint subcommittee members by February 6.
Fifty lawmakers were named to the committee, 27 Republicans and 23 Democrats. The panel's Democratic leader, Charles Stenholm of Texas, said two Democratic seats were vacant.
